notes.title: Created new and improved Arcade Builder tool!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/1d9a6c76b618b8d7b4564d388959a3cb833469be.png[/img]
[b]Dear Retro Fans,[/b]

For those who missed it, please take a look at our previous announcement which goes into detail with what we’ve recently been up to: http://steamcommunity.com/games/465780/announcements/detail/1471979126291199601
Well, we promised you we are still here and have been working on Neon. Santa has arrived early with a nice gift for you: [b]New and improved Arcade Builder tool with new system for customising your perfect Arcade and more![/b]

[list]
[*][h1]Here are the latest patch notes:[/h1]
[b]Fixed[/b] Color setting for console cartridges didn't work.
[b]Fixed[/b]  GameBro backlight enabled by default.
[b]Fixed[/b]  Special Cabinet screens aren't aligned properly which lead to pixel bleed.

[b]Added[/b] missing formats.
[b]Added[/b] New Radio Stations for Boombox.
[b]Added[/b] Launch Options into map (Classic, Neon) for the Arcade Builder .
[b]Added[/b] Asynchronous Texture Streaming System for faster Texture and Level loading.

[b]Created[/b] new and improved Arcade Builder tool.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/616aec7c3809b64917a386c25583742353160087.png[/img]
This new Arcade Builder works with the new Arcade format used in Neon to improve usage with multiple custom arcades and content.

Check out the tools button on the top bar to begin importing and fixing legacy-arcade format XML files to work with the new format.

Create a layout from the heading on the left to specify the locations of each arcade or cartridge in the map.

You can drag and drop nodes from the list onto the layout map itself, or onto the list of nodes on the right.

Also, you can right click on nodes or tabs to find more options. 

([i]More information about New Arcade Builder tool below:[/i])
[code][h1]New Features:[/h1]
[b]Arcade Layout System[/b] - Create a Layout which specifies the location of your custom arcades within the environment. (Instead of one entire template for the whole arcade)

[b]Legacy Import Tools[/b]  - Import your old arcades from the old XML format to the new JSON format, they can then be used in your custom Layouts.

[b]Tabs[/b]  - You can edit multiple peices of content at once with a more intuative and tab-based interface.

[b]Audio Previews[/b] - You can preview your audio files for Attract Screens or Tapes within the builder.

[b]Texture Previews[/b] - You can now preview textures in any supported format, within the builder.

[b]Filters[/b] - You can use filters to help narrow down a large list of user content to a specific game or platform.

[b]Themes[/b]  - Some people want a more professional and clean interface, we have the option for them!

[i]Please note this version is still a work in progress, certain features may not be fully implemented at the moment.[/i][/code]
        
[/list]
We hope you have an amazing festive break and enjoy your time off with family and friends. Bring on 2018!

Have fun in-game! - [b]Joe[/b]

[b]Warmest Regards & Festive Cheers,[/b]
Digital Cybercherries Ltd.

notes.title: Added LightGun support! - Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Arcade Goer’s,[/b]

As you know, we constantly monitor your feedback and really listen to what it is you are saying. On that note, the festive season has come early and we welcome you with a gift; [b][i]LightGun support![/i][/b]

If you require help calibrating your LightGun games, please see the LightGun set-up section in the Arcade Builder Guide below: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=736005082
From everyone at DCC, we sincerely hope you have a fantastic Festive holiday. Be safe and have fun.  For the next couple of weeks, we may be a little slower with responding and releasing updates as we will be visiting family and friends, but don’t worry, we’ll be back in full force soon enough.

Find out the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
[b]https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support[/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Here are the latest patch notes:[/h1]
[*][b]Added[/b] -debugLightgun as a launch option so you can trace the center of the LightGun cabinet screen for calibration. ([i]You may need to disable Multi Res Shading[/i])

[*][b]Added[/b] nra.LightgunCalibrationX and nra.LightgunCalibrationY as console commands. ([i]See Arcade Builder Guide for explanation on how to use this command)[/i]

[*][b]Added[/b] –ArcadeMachines – Example: ([i]-ArcadeMachines=arcade2.xml)[/i] This launch option allows users to have multiple xml files for different Arcade set-ups. 

[*][b]Added[/b] fallback option if in case there is no xml file present for the Arcade machines.

[b]Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.[/b]

notes.title: Added Oculus Touch Improvements!
notes.content:
[b]Dear VR friends,[/b]

Today we release a few Oculus Touch improvements as well as having the privilege of announcing our new title we are working on; [b]HYPERCHARGE: Unboxed[/b] - [i]A co-op FPS game.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/97e25c525ff53e445b6cd35e7fa3a78b1ae94620.png[/img]
It's the final push. With only 24 hours left to vote for [b]New Retro Arcade: Neon[/b] at the VRDB Awards, please ask friends and family to vote too. Thank you to everyone so much who have voted and who are continuing to spread the word. We can win this! http://www.vrdb.com/groups/2016-vr-of-the-year-awards/top50#vote50776

Find out the current status of development by visiting our Trello support board below:
[b]https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support[/b]
[list]
[*][h1]Here are the latest patch notes:[/h1]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES #04 – Huge update - Bar area added & much more!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25478790/24fee9afeb817a79b1befdf7387665477f7e6c74.png[/img]
[h1]Bar area now added to Neon.[/h1]
	
Dear Community,

It's been nearly 2 weeks since the release of New Retro Arcade: Neon and what a couple of weeks it has been. As many of you will already know, the launch did not go as smoothly as it could have. Our attempt to add additional content at the last minute led to unexpected issues arising. Some features were not fully functional and others did not meet expectations.

We are truly grateful that the community has rallied around us and been so supportive as we work to improve and expand the experience. The understanding the community has shown, even throughout this bumpy start, means the world to us. 

We will continue working hard to update the game; we have already released many fixes and patches, as well as taking on board all feedback. To show our appreciation our art team has been expanding the Arcade, even as the coders rectify the issues. It’s been a long couple of weeks with some very late nights, but finally we’re proud to announce that the Arcade Bar is now open!

With your continued support, we can and will make New Retro Arcade: Neon one of the best VR games. Thank you.
 
[i]As I mention quite a lot, we have a Trello support board which gives you the ability to view the current status of development. See more below:[/i]

[b]https://trello.com/b/xc1WU1Fx/newretroarcade-neon-support[/b]

[list]
[*][h1]Here are the latest patch notes:[/h1]

[/list]
[list]

 [*][b]Added[/b] Bar Area to Neon map. [*][b]Added[/b] games console trigger input, right trigger should no longer press 'B'.
 [*][b] Added [/b] more Arcade Cabinets, Gamebros & VHS Tapes to maps.
 
 [*][b]Added[/b] map overviews to the ArcadeBuilder with item locations. [*][b] Added [/b] fixed Prompt system for controllers. ([i]This will not affect your current XML files. To configure the additional cabinets and VHS Tapes in the Builder, you will need to revert to the new .defaults files or edit your existing XMLs to include the new items.[/i])

[*][b] Added [/b] Added VoIP prompt system. (See the options menu for your default key.)
[*][b] Added [/b] Added customizable VHS Tape labels.
[*][b] Added [/b] Added support for DualShock4.

[*][b]Fixed[/b] multiplayer servers not properly ending sessions.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Keybinding locking up the screen.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] controller prompts, these should now be displayed correctly.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Bowling Alley scoring and sounds.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Boxing Machine hit detection for motion controllers.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] stat based achivements not correctly registering.
[*][b]Fixed[/b] Server Hosts hearing multiple flashlight sounds. 

[*][b]Updated[/b] the Projector networking to increase stability and added a video quality override for lower speed connections. To enable lower quality video simply add the following text to your steam launch option: -lowvideotest.

[*][b] Added [/b] High Quality Audio Tracks for the Soundtrack (Files are now available as FLAC)
[*][b] Added [/b] 5 Playalong Audio Tracks for the guitar (sorted by different skill levels):

You can download them by visiting the link below:
[i]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/1357989/NRAN%20Playbacks.zip[/i]


[/list]
Thank you so much for sticking by us. As our slogan states; we are Powered By You.

Your Community Manager Joe and the rest of The Digital Cybercherries team.
